title: Pointwise comma-category computation of derived presheaf left Kan extension
statement: Let $u:\mathcal E\to\mathcal D$ be a functor of small categories in [def-weil-size-convention], each with the topology generated by singleton identity coverings, so all presheaves are sheaves [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Fix a commutative ring $R$ and use $R$-module presheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $g^{-1}$ be precomposition with $u$ and let $g_!=\operatorname{Lan}_{u^{op}}$ be its left adjoint. Write $Lg_!$ for its total left derived functor on derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with the canonical derived adjunction, as in [lem-trf-continuous-cocontinuous-derived-shriek]. For $V\in\mathcal D$, define $\mathcal I_V=(V\downarrow u)$: objects are $(U,a:V\to uU)$ and arrows $(U,a)\to(U',a')$ are $h:U\to U'$ satisfying $u(h)a=a'$. Let $F$ be a module presheaf on $\mathcal E$ in degree zero, and set $F_V(U,a)=F(U)$ with restriction along $h$ given by $F(h)$. Evaluation of $Lg_!F$ at $V$ is canonically represented by the category bar complex $K_{\mathcal I_V}(F_V)$ of [lem-trf-derived-colimit-bar]. In particular $H^{-n}((Lg_!F)(V))=H^{-n}(K_{\mathcal I_V}(F_V))$ for every $n\geq0$, and its positive cohomology vanishes. For a presheaf $K$ on $\mathcal D$ and $F=g^{-1}K$, the derived adjunction counit at $V$ is represented by the augmentation $K_{\mathcal I_V}(F_V)\to K(V)[0]$ sending the degree-zero generator $((U,a),x)$ to $K(a)(x)$. These identifications commute with restrictions in $V$ and maps of coefficient presheaves.

proof.text: For the singleton-isomorphism pretopologies every presheaf is a sheaf; kernels and cokernels are objectwise, so evaluation and precomposition are exact. Any $u$ preserves these coverings and their pullback squares and is cocontinuous (use the identity cover to refine an isomorphism cover). Apply [lem-trf-continuous-cocontinuous-derived-shriek] with constant $R$ and identity structural map to obtain $Lg_!$, $\varepsilon$, and its normalized adjunction. All comma categories and finite-chain indices are small.

proof.text: The auxiliary total derived colimits exist by [lem-trf-derived-colimit-bar]. By [lem-trf-representable-sum-shriek-acyclic], the presheaf categories have enough projectives and arbitrary coefficient-representable sums are left $g_!$-acyclic. The left adjoint $g_!$ preserves direct sums and cokernels by their universal properties and is additive, hence right exact. The functorial nonpositive resolution $\alpha_F:B(F)\to F[0]$ of [lem-trf-augmented-presheaf-bar-resolution] has these sums as terms. Apply [lem-trf-bounded-above-acyclic-derived-computation] to obtain the coefficient-natural isomorphism $i_F=\varepsilon_{B(F)}(Lg_!Q\alpha_F)^{-1}:Lg_!F\xrightarrow\sim Q(g_!B(F))$.

source.place: Tag 08PK (lemma-compute-left-derived-g-shriek), with base site the point; Tags 08PG (example-left-derived-colimits) and 08PH (example-morphism-categories).

proof.text: Evaluation is exact by step 1, so it descends through localization. Compose its image of $i_F$ with the specified derived isomorphism $Q(\beta_{F,V})$ of [lem-trf-shriek-bar-comma-reindexing]. This identifies $(Lg_!F)(V)$ with $K_{\mathcal I_V}(F_V)$ in $D(R)$. That node's restriction and coefficient equations, together with naturality of $i_F$, give both required naturalities. Apply the cohomology functors: $H^{-n}$ gives the claimed isomorphisms, and positive cohomology vanishes since the bar complex has zero positive terms, including the empty-comma case.

source.place: Tag 08PK (lemma-compute-left-derived-g-shriek), with base site the point; Tags 08PG (example-left-derived-colimits) and 08PH (example-morphism-categories).

proof.text: For $F=g^{-1}K$, use [lem-trf-augmented-copower-derived-counit] with $C=B(F)$ and $\alpha=\alpha_F$ from step 2. Its degree-zero identity-summand maps are $f_U=1_{K(uU)}$, so the ordinary transpose has formula $c_V(t,x)=K(t)x$. The node gives $e_K=Q(c)i_F$. Under the chain map $\beta_{F,V}$ of step 3, this is exactly the requested comma augmentation. The same node's equations $K(s)c_V=c_{V'}(g_!C)(s)$ and $q[0]c=c'g_!(v)$, with the two naturalities of $\beta$, prove the asserted counit compatibility.
